_doc: Guardrails for the Learning Agent. learning/guard.py enforces this file; the agent must not edit policy.json, guard.py, collect.py or analyze.py.

min_sample.note: A group = Reels sharing one value of one dimension. Below per_group: report as 'sampel kurang', no conclusion. A config change needs per_group_for_change in BOTH compared groups.

min_effect.note: Median reach of the better group must beat the other by >= 25% before any change; smaller gaps are noise.

hook_and_caption_style: No pipeline code reads a hook/caption-style config key yet (playbook experiments are not consumed by produce.py). Findings on hook_type and caption style are logged as hypotheses/lessons only until the owner approves a consumer.
